result.topic_en: The page gives Laplace-type expansions and product identities for determinants written in minor notation, then the mean error √(αβn) of the expected number of occurrences of an event, worked for α=β=½ and n=1000000.

methods.what: Expansion of a 5×5 determinant along its last column by 4×4 minors (Laplace expansion)
Determinant identity relating the full determinant times a complementary minor to products of bordered minors (Sylvester/Desnanot–Jacobi type)
Alternating sum of products of 4×4 and 3×3 minors (determinant relation)
Expected number of occurrences in n trials of an event with probability α
methods.quote:
In n Fällen hat man also $\alpha n$ mahl A,
und $\beta n$ mahl B (= Nicht A) zu erwarten
